name: Hanapon Princess
source:
One afternoon, after a trip to an antique store, it turns out that a simple statue is actually a magical being from the land of Hanapon. 

But who’s the better candidate to rule? Meet and talk with all the sisters and decide for yourself!

[From [url=https://kavorka.itch.io/hanapon-princess]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某個下午，逛過古董店之後，你發現一尊看似普通的雕像，竟是來自哈納龐國度的魔法生物。

但誰才是更適合統治的候選人呢？與姊妹們一一見面、交談，然後親自做出決定吧！

[摘自[url=https://kavorka.itch.io/hanapon-princess]Itch.io[/url]]
